validation_contract: Every generated run index appears exactly once per target in the run inventory.
Every mapped run is real and appears in exactly one mapping; mapped and unmapped partitions cover the full record.
Run endpoints, elevations and normals are copied from the frozen generated record; lengths and bearings are derived from those endpoints.
Mappings marked contiguous have exact endpoint continuity; Building 2 explicitly uses a contiguous envelope with unmapped embedded returns.
Observed-facing checks use actual resolved panorama viewpoints and an 85 degree ordinary threshold; Maceo run 7 alone has a documented 95 degree grazing-return exception.
Maceo inner courtyard runs 21..39 remain unmapped and prohibited from outer-facade spill.
